رَجُلٌ زَوَّارٌ and ↓ زَؤُورٌ [A man who visits much]: a poet says, “إِذَا غَابَ عَنْهَا بَعْلُهَا لَمْ أَكُنْ لَهَا
وَلَمْ تَأْنَسْ إِلَىَّ كِلَابُهَا ↓ زَؤُورًا
” [When her husband is absent from her, I am not to her a frequent visiter, nor do her dogs become familiar to me]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
